name: Ari Real Estate (Arena) Investment Ltd
summary: Ari Real Estate (Arena) Investment Ltd engages in real estate business in Israel and internationally. It is also involved in the leasing, management, and maintenance of shopping malls and commercial centers. The company was formerly known as Arena Star Group Ltd. and changed its name to Ari Real Estate (Arena) Investment Ltd in March 2022. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Ashdod, Israel.
